observation.visible_scene: Night exterior over a calm pond/lake. A low industrial skyline with scattered white lights and a tall lattice transmission tower on the right sits on the horizon. In the sky above the skyline, a drone light show forms three illuminated Chinese characters (yellow-white dot matrix) at left-center, with a fainter horizontal row of dots higher up. Two diagonal searchlight beams cut across the left sky. The bright character formation and skyline lights reflect in the dark water below.
visible_changes: The three-character drone formation holds essentially the same position and shape across all frames; no translation, expansion, or reconfiguration of the glyphs is visible within the excerpt.

The dot brightness/hue of the characters oscillates subtly frame to frame, shifting between warmer yellow and brighter white (e.g., yellow-dominant around frames 1-2, whiter around frames 6-9, yellow again later), indicating an ongoing flicker/animation rather than a start or stop.
The water reflection of the characters correspondingly brightens and dims and shifts hue in step with the sky formation, confirming it is a reflection of the same lights, not a separate object.
The faint upper horizontal row of dots and the skyline/tower remain static in position; the searchlight beams on the left persist.
The background skyline and tower stay fixed relative to the frame edges, so the camera is effectively static; apparent changes are in the lights, not viewpoint.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the drone formation was assembled before this segment and whether it dissolves or changes after the last frame.
What the faint upper row of dots represents or spells.
The meaning/identity of the displayed text and the event context.
uncertain_details: Whether the yellow-white oscillation is an intentional color animation of the drones or partly exposure/sensor flicker.
Any very small camera drift is not clearly supported; treated as static.
The exact glyph strokes are low-resolution and may be misread.
